options.text: Shut off the sink valve, put a bucket under the drip, and call a plumber
Wrap the joint with tape and keep using the sink normally
Ignore it until the weekend and mop when it puddles

reference.rationale_full: A steady drip inside a cabinet causes mold and wood damage within days. Tape does not fix a pressurized joint and ignoring it lets water spread. Stopping the supply and getting a repair contains damage at low cost.
reference.rationale_short: Stop the water first, then get a proper repair before damage spreads.

state: Water is dripping from the pipe joint under the kitchen sink and the cabinet floor is damp.

options.text: Pay a cash deposit on the spot to hold the car before someone else buys it
Pay for an independent mechanic inspection and check the service history
Trust the low mileage on the dashboard and skip further checks

reference.rationale_full: Used cars can hide accident damage, rolled-back mileage, or worn parts. An independent inspection and history check reveal costly faults. A rushed deposit or blind trust risks buying those problems.
reference.rationale_short: An independent check costs little compared to hidden repair bills.

state: You found an affordable five-year-old car from a private seller who says it runs perfectly and has low mileage.

options.text: Keep charging it overnight but check if it gets hot
Poke a small hole in the back cover to release the pressure
Stop using it, power it off, and take it to a service point or battery recycling

reference.rationale_full: A swollen lithium battery is a fire and chemical risk that worsens with charging or puncturing. Powering it down and handing it to professionals removes the hazard. Continuing to use it or piercing it can cause fire or injury.
reference.rationale_short: A swollen battery is a fire risk: stop charging and get expert handling.

state: Your two-year-old phone battery is swollen, the back cover is lifting, and the phone gets warm while charging.

options.text: Accept the slightly lower fixed salary with a clear written contract and defined hours
Accept the higher-paying offer that promises a big future bonus but only verbally
Reject both and keep job hunting with no income while rent is due

reference.rationale_full: Verbal bonus promises are unenforceable and often shrink or vanish. A written contract with defined pay and hours is reliable income. Turning down both with bills due adds needless financial strain.
reference.rationale_short: Guaranteed written terms beat an uncertain verbal bonus.

state: You have two job offers: one pays slightly less but gives a written contract with fixed hours, the other pays more on paper but the bonus is only a verbal promise.

options.text: Paint over the dark patches and run a scented candle to cover the smell
Find and fix the moisture source, clean the mold properly, and ventilate the room
Scrub the surface with water only and close the door to that room

reference.rationale_full: Mold returns unless the moisture source is fixed, and painting over it traps spores that affect breathing. Proper cleaning plus ventilation and drying removes the cause. Surface-only fixes leave the health risk in place.
reference.rationale_short: Mold must be removed at its moisture source, not painted over.

state: Dark mold patches with a musty smell appeared on the bedroom wall near the window after a rainy month.

options.text: Click the link and enter your login to verify the account quickly
Reply to the email asking if it is real and wait for an answer
Delete the email and log in through the bank app or official website directly

reference.rationale_full: Urgent account-suspension emails with links are a classic phishing pattern to steal credentials. Entering details hands attackers your account. Checking through the official app avoids the trap entirely.
reference.rationale_short: Never log in via email links; use the official app or site.

state: You got an email saying your bank account will be suspended today unless you click a link and confirm your password.

options.text: Track spending for one month, cut the biggest flexible costs, and move the savings automatically
Take a payday loan to cover the gap and worry about the budget later
Stop paying utility bills for a month to free up cash for other spending

reference.rationale_full: Overspending without a picture of where money goes leads to debt cycles. Tracking reveals the largest flexible costs to trim sustainably. High-interest loans or skipping utilities add fees and service cutoffs.
reference.rationale_short: Measure spending first, then cut and automate savings.

state: Your monthly expenses keep exceeding your income and the credit card balance is growing each month.

options.text: Remove the smoke alarm battery so it stops beeping at night
Replace the battery and test the alarm, then set a reminder for the next change
Cover the alarm with a towel to muffle the sound until morning

reference.rationale_full: A chirping alarm signals a low battery, and disabling it leaves the home unprotected from fire. Fresh batteries plus a test restore protection. Muffling or removing power keeps the risk while hiding the warning.
reference.rationale_short: A beeping alarm needs a new battery, not silence.

state: The hallway smoke alarm has been chirping every minute since last night.

options.text: Bang on the wall and shout back every time it happens
Write down dates and times, then speak with the neighbor calmly or contact the building manager
Talk to the neighbor politely once, document the noise, and escalate through the building rules if it continues

reference.rationale_full: Retaliation escalates conflict and can violate building rules yourself. A polite direct talk plus a written log creates evidence and a chance to resolve it. Formal escalation with records works better than shouting matches.
reference.rationale_short: Document the noise, talk calmly, then use formal channels.

state: The upstairs neighbor plays loud music after midnight several times a week and you have work early in the morning.

options.text: Take the expired pills anyway since they look fine and the date is only a guideline
Double the dose to make up for lost strength after expiry
Throw them away safely and ask a doctor or pharmacist for a current prescription

reference.rationale_full: Expired antibiotics lose effectiveness and can fail to clear infection while breeding resistance. Doubling the dose adds side-effect risk without restoring potency. A fresh prescription ensures the right drug and dose.
reference.rationale_short: Expired medicine may fail or harm; get a current prescription.

state: You found leftover antibiotics that expired a year ago and wonder whether to use them for a sore throat.

options.text: Keep driving at highway speed and check the tire next week
Slow down, check the pressure at the next station, and inflate or repair the tire
Let all the air out and refill the tire completely from zero to reset the sensor

reference.rationale_full: Low pressure raises blowout risk, braking distance, and fuel use. Checking and correcting pressure promptly restores safety. Delaying at speed or fully deflating the tire increases the danger.
reference.rationale_short: Low tire pressure needs prompt checking and correction, not delay.

state: The dashboard tire-pressure warning light came on during a highway trip and one tire looks slightly low.

options.text: Start work immediately with no written terms to show good will
Ask for payment in gift cards to avoid bank transfer delays
Agree on scope, deadline, and payment in a short written contract with a deposit

reference.rationale_full: Without written scope and payment terms, disputes over revisions and pay are common and hard to prove. A short contract with a deposit protects both sides. Gift cards signal fraud and offer no protection.
reference.rationale_short: Written scope and payment terms prevent most freelance disputes.

state: A new client wants a website built fast, suggests skipping paperwork, and promises to pay everything after delivery.

options.text: Throw away meat, dairy, and other perishables that warmed up, keep sealed unopened items only if still cool
Cook everything that thawed and put it back in the freezer to be safe
Taste each item and keep whatever still tastes normal

reference.rationale_full: Perishable food above fridge temperature for hours grows bacteria that cooking or tasting cannot reliably detect. Discarding warmed meat and dairy prevents food poisoning. Taste and refreezing do not remove toxins already formed.
reference.rationale_short: After hours without power, discard warmed perishables rather than tasting them.

state: The power was out for six hours overnight and the fridge stayed closed, but the milk and meat feel warm this morning.

options.text: Wrap the child in heavy blankets to sweat the fever out
Give age-appropriate fever medicine per the package, offer fluids, and call the pediatrician if warning signs appear
Give an adult aspirin tablet crushed in juice to bring the fever down fast

reference.rationale_full: Children need weight-based dosing and fluids, plus medical advice if fever is high or persistent. Overheating with blankets worsens discomfort, and aspirin in children risks a serious reaction. Following package dosing with a doctor backup is the safe path.
reference.rationale_short: Use child-appropriate dosing and fluids, and seek medical advice for warning signs.

state: Your six-year-old has a 38.8C fever, is restless, and this is the first evening of the illness.

options.text: Close the account immediately in anger and move everything without reading the terms
Pay the fee silently every month to avoid any hassle
Ask the bank for an explanation in writing, check the fee schedule, and compare cheaper account options

reference.rationale_full: Unexpected fees may come from a changed tariff or an avoidable condition like minimum balance. A written explanation plus the fee schedule shows whether it can be removed. Comparing options then allows a calm, informed switch.
reference.rationale_short: Get the fee explained in writing, then compare alternatives.

state: Your bank charged a new monthly maintenance fee you do not recognize on a previously free account.

options.text: Place a bucket under the drip, move valuables, and call a roofer for an urgent repair
Drill a bigger hole in the ceiling so the water drains faster
Wait for the next heavy rain to confirm the leak is really a problem

reference.rationale_full: A storm-driven ceiling leak soaks insulation and framing, so containing water and protecting belongings limits damage. Professional repair seals the entry point. Enlarging the hole or waiting for more rain increases structural harm.
reference.rationale_short: Contain the water and get the roof repaired before damage grows.

state: After last night's storm, a brown water stain is spreading on the living-room ceiling with slow drips.

options.text: Accept both interviews at the same time and decide later which one to attend
Contact one employer promptly, explain the clash, and ask to reschedule to another slot
Skip both interviews to avoid choosing and hope new invitations come

reference.rationale_full: Double-booking and no-showing burns bridges with employers who track reliability. A polite reschedule request keeps both opportunities alive. Skipping both wastes two chances for no benefit.
reference.rationale_short: Ask to reschedule one interview instead of missing either.

state: Two promising job interviews were scheduled for the same Tuesday morning and neither employer knows about the other.

options.text: Reuse the same password everywhere so there is only one to remember and change
Ignore the breach notice because the site looked small and unimportant
Change the exposed passwords, enable two-factor authentication, and check account activity

reference.rationale_full: Leaked passwords are tested automatically against email, banking, and shopping sites. Changing them and adding a second factor blocks that reuse attack. Ignoring the notice or reusing one password leaves every account exposed.
reference.rationale_short: Treat a breach notice as urgent: change passwords and add two-factor protection.

state: You received a breach notice that an online shop where you reused your email password was hacked.

options.text: Meet the seller, test the laptop with your own programs, check the serial number, and pay with a traceable method
Wire the full price in advance to reserve the laptop without seeing it
Buy it without testing because the photos look clean and the price is very low

reference.rationale_full: Secondhand electronics carry risks of faults, stolen goods, or scams. Hands-on testing, serial checks, and traceable payment verify what you buy. Advance wires or photo-only buys remove all leverage if it is defective.
reference.rationale_short: Test the device in person and keep payment traceable.

state: An online seller offers a barely used laptop at half the shop price and prefers cash or advance transfer.

options.text: Assume the meter is wrong and refuse to pay the bill
Check for running toilets and dripping taps, read the meter, and call the water company about a possible leak
Stop using water entirely until the next bill arrives

reference.rationale_full: A sudden usage spike usually means a silent toilet leak or a misread meter. Checking fixtures and comparing meter readings identifies the cause. Refusing payment or stopping all use does not find the leak and adds penalties.
reference.rationale_short: Look for leaks and verify the meter before disputing the bill.

state: Your water bill tripled this month even though your household habits did not change.

options.text: Plug in another heater on the same cord to finish the job faster
Coil the cord tightly under the rug so nobody trips over it
Unplug the cord, let it cool, and use a shorter, thicker rated cord or another outlet

reference.rationale_full: Heat in an extension cord signals overload or too-thin wire, a common cause of electrical fires. Disconnecting and switching to a properly rated cord removes the overload. Adding load or trapping heat under a rug makes ignition more likely.
reference.rationale_short: A hot cord is overloaded: unplug it and use a properly rated connection.

state: The extension cord powering a space heater feels hot to the touch and smells faintly of warm plastic.

options.text: Photograph the apartment, compare with the move-in report, and dispute the charge in writing
Accept the deduction silently even though you cleaned and nothing was damaged
Threaten the landlord on social media to get the money back faster

reference.rationale_full: Deposit disputes are decided by documented condition, not claims. Photos plus the move-in report and a written dispute create a clear record. Silent acceptance loses valid money while public threats harm your legal position.
reference.rationale_short: Use photos and the move-in report to dispute deposit charges in writing.

state: After moving out, the landlord kept half your deposit for cleaning and damage you believe did not happen.

options.text: Pour leftover paint down the toilet and put cans in the regular trash
Take the leftover paint to the municipal hazardous-waste collection point
Dump the paint behind the garage where nobody walks

reference.rationale_full: Paint contains solvents and metals that pollute water and soil and can bring fines. Collection points handle it safely and often for free. Drains, trash, or dumping spread contamination and liability.
reference.rationale_short: Leftover paint is hazardous waste and belongs at a collection point.

state: After repainting the hallway, you have three half-full cans of old paint you no longer need.

options.text: Turn the heating off completely while away for a week to save money
Leave a window open while the heating runs to keep air fresh
Keep low background heating, insulate exposed pipes, and ask someone to check the house

reference.rationale_full: Frozen pipes burst and cause far costlier damage than a week of low heating. Background heat plus insulation keeps water above freezing. Shutting heat off or venting heat outside invites a freeze.
reference.rationale_short: Low steady heat plus pipe insulation prevents costly pipe bursts.

state: A hard frost is forecast while you will be away from home for a week in winter.

options.text: Decline to share the login and ask IT to grant the coworker their own access
Log in for the coworker and let them work under your name
Share your password with the coworker to save time

reference.rationale_full: Shared logins erase accountability and often violate security policy, leaving you responsible for misuse. A separate account gives proper permissions and audit trails. Working under your name carries the same risk as sharing.
reference.rationale_short: Never share logins; each person needs their own authorized access.

state: A coworker asks for your work system password because their own access has not been set up yet.

No

reference.rationale_full: Tenants have a right to privacy and advance notice except for genuine emergencies like fire or burst pipes. A routine inspection without notice violates that protection. The landlord should schedule the visit with proper notice.
reference.rationale_short: Routine entry requires advance notice; only emergencies allow immediate access.

state: Is the landlord allowed to enter your rented apartment without any notice for a routine inspection while you are away?

options.text: Yes
No

reference.rationale_full: Cooking oil hardens in pipes and causes severe blockages and sewer backups. It should be cooled, sealed in a container, and disposed of properly. The sink is never a safe disposal route.
reference.rationale_short: Oil clogs drains and sewers; it must be collected, not poured away.

state: Is it acceptable to pour leftover cooking oil down the kitchen sink if you flush with hot water afterwards?

options.text: Yes
No

reference.rationale_full: A burst pipe floods rooms within minutes and damages floors, walls, and neighbors below. Closing the main valve immediately limits that damage. Waiting for a plumber first wastes critical time.
reference.rationale_short: Shutting the main valve fast is the key step to limit flood damage.

state: Should you shut off the main water valve right away if a pipe bursts and water is spraying across the room?

options.text: Yes
No

reference.rationale_full: A charger with exposed conductors can short, overheat, or shock the user even under tape. Damaged chargers are cheap to replace compared to fire or injury. It should be retired and replaced with a certified one.
reference.rationale_short: Exposed wiring is a shock and fire risk that tape cannot make safe.

state: Is it safe to keep using a phone charger with cracked insulation and visible wires if you wrap it in tape?

options.text: Yes
No

reference.rationale_full: Cash rent without proof is hard to dispute if the landlord later claims nonpayment. A signed receipt with date and amount creates simple protection. Keeping it costs nothing and prevents costly disagreements.
reference.rationale_short: A written receipt is the only proof of a cash rent payment.

state: Should you always get a written receipt when you pay your monthly rent in cash?

options.text: Yes
No

reference.rationale_full: Prescription antibiotics are chosen for a specific person, infection, and dose. Taking someone else's drug risks wrong treatment, allergy, and resistance. A doctor should evaluate the symptoms first.
reference.rationale_short: Never take another person's prescription; the drug and dose may be wrong for you.

state: Is it okay to take antibiotics prescribed to a family member because your symptoms look similar?

options.text: Yes
No

reference.rationale_full: Large repair bills often grow with hidden extras added without approval. A written estimate with parts and labor lets you compare and dispute. Approving work blindly removes that control.
reference.rationale_short: A written estimate prevents surprise charges on big repairs.

state: Should you get a written cost estimate before approving a car repair expected to cost several hundred?

options.text: Yes
No

reference.rationale_full: Unattended heaters tip over or overheat nearby fabrics, a leading cause of winter house fires. They should run only while someone is present and awake. Leaving one on overnight trades comfort for serious risk.
reference.rationale_short: Space heaters must never run unattended or while sleeping.

state: Is it safe to leave a portable electric space heater running overnight in an empty living room?

options.text: Yes
No

reference.rationale_full: Traffic lights exist because cross traffic, pedestrians, and cameras cannot be fully judged at night. Running one risks a crash and a fine. Stopping keeps the intersection predictable for everyone.
reference.rationale_short: Red lights apply at all hours; empty roads still hide cross traffic.

state: Must you still stop at a red traffic light at 3 a.m. when no other cars are visible?

options.text: Yes
No

reference.rationale_full: Blank signed documents can be filled with terms you never agreed to, and your signature makes them hard to challenge. Legitimate employers provide complete contracts to read first. Never sign what you cannot read.
reference.rationale_short: A blank signature hands away control over the final terms.

state: Is it safe to sign a blank employment contract and trust the employer to fill in the salary and duties later?

options.text: Yes
No

reference.rationale_full: Detectors fail silently through dead batteries, dust, or age. A quick monthly press of the test button confirms it will sound in a real fire. Skipping tests leaves failure undiscovered.
reference.rationale_short: Monthly testing is the only way to know the alarm will work.

state: Should you test your home smoke detector once a month using its test button?

options.text: Yes
No

reference.rationale_full: Riding unlit on a dark road makes the cyclist nearly invisible to drivers until it is too late. Lights and reflectors are cheap, often legally required, and prevent collisions. Darkness is not a valid exception.
reference.rationale_short: Cyclists need lights on dark roads to be seen and stay legal.

state: Is it acceptable to ride a bicycle at night on an unlit road without any front or rear light?

options.text: Yes
No

reference.rationale_full: Suspicious messages are designed to steal logins through fake pages. Reporting them to the bank or email provider helps block the attack. Clicking first gives attackers exactly what they want.
reference.rationale_short: Report phishing instead of engaging with it.

state: Should you report a suspicious prize message asking for bank details instead of clicking its link?

options.text: Yes
No

reference.rationale_full: Final wages are protected by labor rules and cannot be held hostage over unreturned items, which are handled separately. The employer can request the uniform back or deduct only what the law allows. Withholding the whole paycheck is not a lawful remedy.
reference.rationale_short: Final pay is legally protected and cannot be withheld over a uniform.

state: Is an employer allowed to withhold your entire final paycheck just because you have not returned a work uniform yet?

options.text: Yes
No

reference.rationale_full: Breaker trips signal overload or a fault that repeats under the same load. An electrician can find undersized wiring or a failing appliance before it overheats. Repeatedly resetting hides the warning.
reference.rationale_short: A tripping breaker is a warning that needs professional diagnosis.

state: Should you call an electrician if the same circuit breaker trips every time you use the oven and the microwave together?
